Authors: Yulu Wu, Chao Wei, Jujun Cheng, Zhangkai Ni, Haowen Wang, Dengyang Suo, Cong Chen, Xinyi Liu, Shangce Gao

ALDER: Discovering the Laws of a World by Acting in It WorldModel

equation discovery world model active learning robotic control out-of-distribution prediction

简要说明：ALDER通过主动设计实验来提出和验证基于方程的世界模型，能够发现和修正定律，并用于目标导向控制，在机器人任务上得到验证。

TLDR: ALDER actively proposes and tests equation-based world models through novel experiments, enabling discovery, revision, and use of explicit laws for control, validated on robotic tasks.

Abstract: Reliable world models should not only predict future states but express how actions change the world in an explicit, transparent and testable form, such as equations. Yet methods that rely on a fixed set of trajectories cannot distinguish equally good competing hypotheses, while searches over a fixed set of predefined candidates cannot discover equations outside the initial hypothesis space. We introduce ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision), a method that actively proposes novel experiments to test and revise models. Specifically, ALDER proposes parametric equations; a numerical optimizer fits their coefficients; an independent verifier tests these candidates on held-out data. To distinguish between competing valid hypotheses, a cost- and safety-aware selector queries interventions, in the form of novel experiments. The resulting counterexamples update the evidence ledger and guide the next structural revision, while incompatible laws are discarded. Across an in-house benchmark, ODE equation discovery tasks, and robotic experiments, ALDER discovers laws beyond its initial formula set, repairs failed model proposals, distinguishes fixed candidate models with fewer interactions, and improves out-of-distribution prediction. Furthermore, given a current state and a target, ALDER selects control actions by solving the inverse problem defined by its validated world model. Together, these results show that explicit equation-based world models can be tested and revised through interaction, then naturally used to guide goal-directed control.

摘要（中文）：可靠的世界模型不仅应预测未来状态，还应以明确、透明且可检验的形式（如方程）表达行动如何改变世界。然而，依赖固定轨迹集的方法无法区分同样有效的竞争性假设，而对固定预定义候选集的搜索则无法发现初始假设空间之外的方程。我们引入了ALDER（行动引导的定律发现、评估与修订），这是一种主动提出新实验以检验和修订模型的方法。具体而言，ALDER提出参数化方程；数值优化器拟合其系数；独立的验证器在留出数据上测试这些候选模型。为了区分相互竞争的合理假设，一个考虑成本与安全的选择器以新实验的形式查询干预措施。由此产生的反例更新证据台账并指导下一步的结构修订，同时不兼容的定律被丢弃。在内部基准测试、常微分方程发现任务以及机器人实验中，ALDER发现了超出其初始公式集的定律，修复了失败的模型提案，以更少的交互区分了固定候选模型，并改善了分布外预测。此外，给定当前状态和目标，ALDER通过求解由其验证过的世界模型定义的逆问题来选择控制动作。这些结果共同表明，基于方程的显式世界模型可以通过交互进行测试和修订，并自然地用于指导目标导向的控制。

Authors: Teng Cao, Yu Deng, Quentin Delfosse, Kristian Kersting

Adaptive Latent Capacity for World Models WorldModel

joint-embedding predictive architecture adaptive prefix length MixSIGReg goal-conditioned visual control recursive planning

简要说明：ALeWM提出了一种基于自适应前缀的JEPA世界模型，通过MixSIGReg正则化将预测信息集中在紧凑的潜在前缀中，在目标条件视觉控制中实现了更高的成功率并降低了规划容量。

TLDR: ALeWM introduces an adaptive-prefix JEPA world model that concentrates predictive information in compact latent prefixes and uses MixSIGReg regularization, achieving higher success rates in goal-conditioned visual control with reduced planning capacity.

Abstract: We introduce Adaptive LeWorldModel (ALeWM), a world model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns to concentrate predictive information in compact prefixes of a wide latent representation. To encourage this ordering, ALeWM learns a sequence-conditioned distribution over prefix lengths and trains the predictor to estimate the full next embedding from a sampled input prefix. As standard anti-collapse objectives encourage variation across latent coordinates and do not organize them by predictive importance, we also introduce MixSIGReg. MixSIGReg regularizes the masked embeddings against a prior-weighted mixture with Gaussian active prefixes and zeros in the remaining coordinates. As a result, the ALeWM objective encourages early coordinates to retain information useful for prediction and recursive planning. Our analysis shows that the mixture distribution used by MixSIGReg assigns higher variance to earlier coordinate blocks and lower variance to later ones. In addition, we show that, under specified assumptions, prediction error is minimized by placing the information most useful for prediction in earlier blocks. Empirically, we study the behavior of ALeWM in a controlled dynamical system with known state variables and in goal-conditioned visual control. We show that ALeWM consistently achieves higher mean success rates than tuned fixed-width LeWM, with lower planning capacity on average.

摘要（中文）：我们引入了自适应LeWorldModel（ALeWM），这是一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型，其学习将预测信息集中在宽潜变量表示的紧凑前缀中。为了促进这种排序，ALeWM学习一个以序列为条件的前缀长度分布，并训练预测器从采样的输入前缀中估计完整的下一时刻嵌入。由于标准抗坍塌目标鼓励潜变量坐标之间的变异性，但并未按预测重要性对其进行组织，我们还引入了MixSIGReg。MixSIGReg通过对掩码嵌入施加正则化，使其与结合了高斯活动前缀和其余坐标置零的先验加权混合分布相匹配。因此，ALeWM的目标函数鼓励早期坐标保留对预测和递归规划有用的信息。我们的分析表明，MixSIGReg所使用的混合分布为较早的坐标块分配了更高的方差，而为较晚的坐标块分配了更低的方差。此外，我们证明，在特定假设下，将最有用的预测信息放置在较早的块中能够最小化预测误差。在实验上，我们在一个具有已知状态变量的受控动力系统以及目标条件视觉控制任务中研究了ALeWM的行为。结果表明，与经过调优的固定宽度LeWM相比，ALeWM在平均规划容量更低的情况下，始终实现了更高的平均成功率。

Authors: Idan Achituve, Lior Dikstein, Idit Diamant, Arnon Netzer, Hai Victor Habi

A Disk-Shaped Magnetoelastic Torque Sensor for Robotic Joints Using Permanent Magnetization Manipulation

magnetoelastic torque sensor robotic joints magnetic shielding force-sensitive sensing real robot sensory hardware

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人关节的紧凑盘形磁弹性扭矩传感器，采用四磁力计架构和磁屏蔽，实现高精度和抗干扰，并通过实验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a compact disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor for robotic joints, using a four-magnetometer architecture with magnetic shielding to achieve high accuracy and reject parasitic forces, validated experimentally.

Abstract: Direct torque sensing is a growing need in the robotics community to enable precise control and interactions where torque estimation from motor current is not sufficient. This paper presents a novel disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor with a compact axial envelope of about 1 cm, suitable for integration in robotic joints. A four-magnetometer architecture is used to measure the field modulated by the stress affecting a narrow magnetized region while rejecting the effects of parasitic cross forces. A custom-designed magnetic shield enhances the torque sensitivity while reducing the external stray fields by a factor 7x. The device measures the torque with an accuracy of 1.34 %FS relative to the 50 Nm full scale (FS). The paper details the development of the sensor through the mechanical design, the magnetization procedure, and the experimental validation. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed sensor for robotic applications.

摘要（中文）：直接力矩传感是机器人领域日益增长的需求，因为当仅通过电机电流进行力矩估算不足时，需要实现精确的控制与交互。本文提出了一种新型盘状磁弹性力矩传感器，其轴向结构紧凑，厚度约为1厘米，适合集成于机器人关节中。该传感器采用四磁力计架构，用于测量受应力影响的窄磁化区域所调制的磁场，同时抑制寄生横向力的干扰。定制设计的磁屏蔽罩将力矩灵敏度提升，并将外部杂散磁场降低至原来的七分之一。该器件在50牛米满量程（FS）范围内实现了1.34%FS的力矩测量精度。本文详细介绍了传感器的开发过程，包括机械设计、磁化流程及实验验证。结果表明，所提出的传感器在机器人应用中具有广阔的前景。

Authors: Bruno Brajon, Enrico Gasparin, Nicole Yazigy, Lisa Salamin, Florian Copt, Guzmán Borque Gallego, Elias Klauser, Gaël Close

TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation AutonomousDriving

active domain adaptation semantic segmentation driving scenes vision foundation model one-shot

简要说明：TC-ADA 提出了一种用于驾驶场景语义分割的一次性主动域适应方法，利用视觉基础模型和固定UDA模型选择信息丰富的目标图像，并在有限标签下校准源/目标监督以提升分割性能。

TLDR: TC-ADA proposes a one-shot active domain adaptation method for semantic segmentation in driving scenes, using a vision foundation model and a fixed UDA model to select informative target images and calibrating source/target supervision to improve segmentation under limited labels.

Abstract: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.

摘要（中文）：手动密集标注仍然是阻碍语义分割模型在新驾驶环境中部署的主要障碍。主动域自适应（ADA）旨在通过仅标注目标域的选定部分来实现标签高效迁移。现有的ADA方法通常通过多轮获取、标注和再训练来完成这一过程。我们研究了一种实用的一次性图像级设置，即在单轮中选定并密集标注固定的目标子集，随后进行不间断的自适应。在此设置下，我们提出了目标校准主动域自适应（TC-ADA），作为完整图像获取与目标校准自适应的联合设计。第一阶段利用视觉基础模型（VFM）的视觉表示以及固定无监督域自适应模型的语义预测，在无目标标注的情况下选择具有代表性和信息量的目标图像。第二阶段联合使用有标签源数据、有标签目标数据及剩余的无标签目标数据，并在有限目标标签下对源域和目标域的监督信号进行校准。在五个合成到真实及真实到真实的驾驶迁移任务上的大量实验表明，该方法相较于代表性的ADA基线方法具有一致的性能提升。在四个迁移任务中仅使用23至46张有标签目标图像，在Mapillary上使用140张，TC-ADA的平均交并比（mIoU）与仅使用目标域全监督方法相比差距保持在1.9个百分点以内。代码将在https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA发布。

Authors: Weihao Yan, Yeqiang Qian, Yueyuan Li, Tao Li, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang

AevaScenes: An FMCW LiDAR Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Range Perception Perception3D

FMCW LiDAR Doppler velocity 3D object detection scene flow semantic segmentation

简要说明：本文介绍了AevaScenes，一个大规模FMCW激光雷达数据集，包含多普勒速度标注，并提供了3D目标检测、场景流和语义分割基准，证明多普勒线索显著提升远距离感知。

TLDR: This paper introduces AevaScenes, a large-scale FMCW LiDAR dataset with Doppler velocity annotations, and benchmarks for 3D object detection, scene flow, and semantic segmentation, showing that Doppler cues significantly improve long-range perception.

Abstract: FMCW LiDAR measures per-point radial Doppler velocity alongside range, providing a motion cue unavailable in conventional time-of-flight sensors. Exploiting this signal at long range remains understudied. We present an FMCW LiDAR dataset of 575 sequences (57.5K frames) with over 8 million annotated 3D boxes across 16 detection classes and per-point labels across 24 semantic classes, captured by six commercial FMCW LiDAR sensors and six paired 4K cameras across eight Bay Area cities, including 237 nighttime sequences, with annotations extending to 400m. We define a benchmark with three tasks: 3D object detection, scene flow estimation, and semantic segmentation. Detection and scene flow are evaluated across three range bins to 400m, with a public evaluation server. We explore the impact of Doppler measurements on flagship recognition tasks, and find significant improvements up to 2X in detection AP of far-away vehicles and pedestrians, particularly in low-latency single-frame settings. We similarly find scene flow accuracy is significantly improved with Doppler measurements across all ranges. Our dataset and benchmark have been publicly released at https://scenes.aeva.com.

摘要（中文）：FMCW激光雷达在测距的同时测量每个点的径向多普勒速度，提供了传统飞行时间传感器无法获得的运动线索。利用这一信号进行远距离探测的研究仍相对不足。我们发布了一个包含575个序列（57500帧）的FMCW激光雷达数据集，涵盖16个检测类别的超过800万个标注三维框，以及24个语义类别的逐点标注，数据由六个商用FMCW激光雷达传感器和六对4K相机在湾区八个城市采集，其中包括237个夜间序列，标注范围延伸至400米。我们定义了一个包含三项任务的基准：三维目标检测、场景流估计和语义分割。检测和场景流任务在三个距离区间内进行评估，直至400米，并提供公开评估服务器。我们探究了多普勒测量对核心识别任务的影响，发现对于远距离车辆和行人，检测平均精度（AP）最高可提升2倍，尤其是在低延迟单帧场景中。同样地，我们发现结合多普勒测量后，各距离区间的场景流精度均有显著提升。我们的数据集和基准已在https://scenes.aeva.com上公开发布。

Authors: Gautham Narayan Narasimhan, Heethesh Vhavle, Kumar Bhargav Viswanatha, James Reuther, Deva Ramanan

When Does Backpropagating Through Policy Memory Matter? Physical Credit, Optimizer Updates, and Observability RLRobot

backpropagation through time policy memory credit assignment optimizer updates observability

简要说明：本文研究在基于Transformer的策略中，通过策略记忆进行反向传播何时重要，发现切断记忆梯度的影响取决于物理信用、优化器和噪声，并建议从初始化训练来测量代价。

TLDR: This paper studies when backpropagating through policy memory matters in Transformer-based policies, finding that cutting memory gradients has varying impacts depending on physical credit, optimizer, and noise, and recommending training from initialization to measure the cost.

Abstract: Policies with memory can learn along two backward paths: through the physical states their actions produce and through the representations they store. Transformer-XL and truncated backpropagation through time cut the second path at stored history while keeping its values. We ask when this cut matters. Holding the forward computation fixed and varying only derivative edges, we measure parameter gradients, the updates the optimizer applies, and continued training in a Transformer vessel-trajectory model and a quadrotor tracking policy. In the vessel model, detaching the key-value cache shrank the gradient to about a tenth of its norm, with little rotation, when gradients flowed through all earlier physical states, but barely changed it under one-step physical credit. In this strongly clipped regime the optimizer, not the gradient, set how far updates differed: global-norm clipping removed most of the gradient difference between memory-cut graphs, whereas AdamW turned a 2% gradient difference between two placements of the cut into update differences of up to 31% at the step where the placement was switched. In a quadrotor trained from initialization with 0.20 m/s velocity noise, removing memory raised tracking error by 43% and cutting memory gradients raised it by 32%; at low noise the cut's mean cost exceeded the value of memory. Two-step truncation segments gave no measurable gain, although with hidden velocity a two-step window captured most of the value of memory; eight-step segments removed half to three quarters of the cost. Switching the cut on only for the last fifth of training understated its cost about threefold at 0.20-0.30 m/s, but not at low noise or with hidden velocity. These results suggest measuring the cost of a memory cut by training with it from initialization, and comparing backward graphs by the updates the optimizer applies rather than by raw gradients.

摘要（中文）：具有记忆的策略可以通过两条反向路径进行学习：一条是其所产生动作的物理状态路径，另一条是其存储的表征路径。Transformer-XL和截断式时间反向传播在存储历史处切断第二条路径，同时保留其数值。我们探究这种切断在何种情况下会产生影响。在保持前向计算不变、仅改变导数边的情况下，我们测量了参数梯度、优化器应用的更新量，以及在Transformer船舶轨迹模型和四旋翼跟踪策略中的持续训练表现。在船舶模型中，当梯度流经所有早期的物理状态时，分离键值缓存使梯度范数缩小至约十分之一，且方向旋转很小；但在单步物理信用分配下，该操作几乎不改变梯度。在这种强截断情形下，决定更新差异大小的是优化器而非梯度：全局范数裁剪消除了记忆切断图之间的大部分梯度差异，而AdamW在切换切断位置的步骤中，将两种切断位置之间2%的梯度差异放大为最高31%的更新差异。在从初始化训练且速度噪声为0.20 m/s的四旋翼任务中，移除记忆使跟踪误差增加43%，而切断记忆梯度使其增加32%；在低噪声条件下，切断的平均代价超过了记忆本身的价值。两步截断片段没有带来可测量的收益，尽管在隐藏速度条件下，两步窗口捕获了记忆价值的大部分；八步片段则消除了三分之一至四分之三的代价。仅在训练最后五分之一阶段启用切断，在0.20-0.30 m/s噪声下将其代价低估了约三倍，但在低噪声或隐藏速度条件下则不存在此现象。这些结果表明，应从初始化开始训练以衡量记忆切断的代价，并通过优化器实际应用的更新量而非原始梯度来比较反向计算图。

Authors: Xingjian Li, Yi Han, Jianhua Z. Huang

Beyond Tasks: A Vision for Reproducing an Animal-like Behavioral Substrate Using Modern Robot Learning Techniques HumanoidEmbodied

ethological behavioral substrate robot learning embodied agents social behavior continual learning

简要说明：该论文提出了一个概念框架——行为学行为基底，用于研究具身智能体在持续、协调行为方面的能力，并建议以机器动物伴侣作为长期交互与适应的研究场景，而非提供具体的算法或实证贡献。

TLDR: The paper proposes a conceptual framework—the ethological behavioral substrate—for studying sustained, coordinated behavior in embodied agents, and suggests robotic animal companions as a research setting for long-term interaction and adaptation, rather than presenting a concrete algorithmic or empirical contribution.

Abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have produced increasingly capable embodied agents. Yet comparatively less attention has been given to a more basic form of competence that animals exhibit continuously: the ability to remain situated, responsive, and behaviorally coherent as physical, environmental, and social demands change over time. We propose the ethological behavioral substrate as a conceptual lens for studying this form of competence in artificial agents. Rather than treating these behaviors that animals exhibit as a set of isolated skills, we argue that their continual coordination under competing demands constitutes an important and underexplored target for modern robot learning. We further propose robotic animal companions as a useful research setting for studying sustained interaction and adaptation in human-centered environments. Such systems provide an opportunity to investigate how social behavior, memory, and continual learning develop over long periods of interaction. This perspective motivates further investigation of how such persistent behavioral competence may complement higher-level capabilities in embodied agents.

摘要（中文）：近期机器人学习的进展已经催生了日益强大的具身智能体。然而，相比之下，对于动物持续展现的一种更为基础的能力，关注却相对较少：即在物理、环境和社会需求随时间变化时，保持情境感知、响应性以及行为连贯性的能力。我们提出将动物行为学行为基底作为一种概念透镜，用以研究人工智能体中的这种能力形式。我们不主张将动物展现的这些行为视为一系列孤立的技能，而是认为，在竞争性需求下它们持续的协调构成了现代机器人学习一个重要的、尚未充分探索的目标。我们进一步提出，将机器人动物伴侣作为研究以人为中心环境中持续互动与适应的有效研究场景。此类系统为探究社会行为、记忆和持续学习如何在长期互动过程中发展提供了机会。这一视角促使我们进一步探究，这种持久的行为能力如何与具身智能体中的高层次能力相辅相成。

Authors: Samiyuru Menik, Hemadri Jayalath

Communication-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Decentralized Multi-Human Multi-Robot Task Allocation RLRobot

heterogeneous graph learning multi-agent reinforcement learning task allocation communication-aware multi-human multi-robot

简要说明：CommHG是一种用于分散式多人类多机器人任务分配的通信感知异构图学习框架，通过多智能体强化学习联合优化分配与通信，以应对受限的人机与机器人间链路。

TLDR: CommHG is a communication-aware heterogeneous graph learning framework for decentralized multi-human multi-robot task allocation, jointly optimizing allocation and communication via multi-agent reinforcement learning to handle constrained human-robot and robot-robot links.

Abstract: Multi-human multi-robot (MH-MR) teams combine robotic autonomy with human expertise, but effective task allocation requires coordinating scarce, dynamically available human support with distributed robot execution. Limited robot-robot and human-robot communication further complicates this coupling by delaying information exchange and supervisory intervention. We introduce CommHG, a communication-aware heterogeneous graph learning framework for decentralized MH-MR task allocation. CommHG represents coupled human-robot-task interactions through local graphs conditioned on information availability and age. Learned communication actions enable robots to decide when and which operator to query, and when to share information with peers. Allocation and communication are jointly optimized through cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, allowing the team to acquire useful information while managing limited communication and supervisory resources. We also introduce a benchmark integrating heterogeneous humans and robots, dynamic tasks and operational states, and constrained robot-robot and bidirectional human-robot links. Experiments across heterogeneous teams with up to 16 robots, 6 humans, and 112 tasks show that CommHG improves timely weighted mission completion as coordination scale increases, outperforming the strongest baseline in the Large scenario.

摘要（中文）：多人类多机器人（MH-MR）团队将机器人自主性与人类专业知识相结合，但有效的任务分配需要协调稀缺且动态可用的人类支持与分布式机器人执行之间的配合。有限的机器人间及人机通信进一步增加了这种耦合的复杂性，导致信息交换和监管干预的延迟。我们提出CommHG，一种面向分散式MH-MR任务分配的通信感知异构图学习框架。CommHG通过基于信息可用性和时效性的局部图来表示人与机器人及任务之间的耦合交互。学习得到的通信动作使机器人能够决定何时以及向哪位操作员进行查询，以及何时与同伴共享信息。通过合作式多智能体强化学习，分配与通信被联合优化，使团队能够在管理有限通信和监管资源的同时获取有用信息。我们还引入了一个基准测试，该基准整合了异质性人类与机器人、动态任务与运行状态，以及受限的机器人间和双向人机链路。在包含多达16个机器人、6个人类和112项任务的异构团队的实验中表明，随着协调规模的扩大，CommHG提升了及时加权的任务完成率，在大型场景中超越了最强基线。

Authors: Ziqin Yuan, Ruiqi Wang, Baijian Yang, Byung-Cheol Min

Optimizing H-Graph Hybridization for Diffusion-Guided RRT Other

motion planning diffusion model RRT inference-time diversity H-Graph hybridization

简要说明：本文针对扩散引导的RRT运动规划器，提出了两种推理时多样化策略，并通过H-Graph混合结合，在AntMaze任务中显著提高了轨迹质量。

TLDR: This paper introduces inference-time diversification strategies for a diffusion-guided RRT motion planner, combined via H-Graph hybridization, and shows they improve trajectory quality in AntMaze tasks.

Abstract: Sampling-based motion planners guided by diffusion models produce high-quality trajectories in a single run, yet the stochastic diversity available at inference time is left largely unexploited. We present two inference-time diversification strategies for a fixed, pretrained DiTree model, combined via H-Graph hybridization, and evaluate them on a holonomic AntMaze robot across 15 maze scenarios. The first, factorial diversity, sweeps the random seed and Diffusion Goal Bias (DGB) parameter, the second, refinement-only diversity, sweeps the diffusion refinement strength (RS) that controls how much an RRT-generated trajectory is edited. Because a single-run baseline only partially succeeds, we additionally compare H-Graph results with pool-based statistics. H-Graph improves the mean pool length of the factorial and refinement-only diversities by 18.8% and 14.5%, respectively. In addition, it also improves the best individual candidate's lengths by 9.7% and 6.8%, respectively. And last, compared with the successful baseline's trajectory length, it improves the results by 18.2% and 19.9%, respectively. These results show that inference-time parameter variation is a reliable, training-free source of path diversity, and that H-Graph hybridization reliably converts this diversity into shorter, higher quality trajectories.

摘要（中文）：以扩散模型引导的基于采样的运动规划器能够在单次运行中生成高质量的轨迹，然而推理时可用的随机多样性在很大程度上尚未被充分利用。我们针对一个固定的、预训练的DiTree模型，提出了两种推理时多样化策略，并通过H-Graph杂交将其结合，在15个迷宫场景中对全向AntMaze机器人进行了评估。第一种策略为阶乘多样化，遍历随机种子和扩散目标偏置（DGB）参数；第二种策略为仅细化多样化，遍历控制RRT生成轨迹被编辑程度的扩散细化强度（RS）。由于单次运行的基线方法仅能部分成功，我们还将H-Graph的结果与基于池的统计结果进行了比较。H-Graph将阶乘多样化和仅细化多样化的平均池长度分别提升了18.8%和14.5%。此外，它还将最佳个体候选轨迹的长度分别改善了9.7%和6.8%。最后，与成功基线的轨迹长度相比，它分别将结果提升了18.2%和19.9%。这些结果表明，推理时参数变化是一种可靠的、无需训练的路径多样性来源，而H-Graph杂交能够可靠地将这种多样性转化为更短、更高质量的轨迹。

Authors: Omer Talmi

MA-JEPA: Joint-Embedding World Models for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning WorldModel

joint-embedding prediction world models multi-agent reinforcement learning latent imagination centralized training decentralized execution

简要说明：MA-JEPA 提出了一种用于多智能体强化学习的随机世界模型，用联合嵌入预测替代观测重建，实现了潜在想象下的集中训练与分散执行，并在 SMAC 上表现出色。

TLDR: MA-JEPA introduces a stochastic world model for multi-agent reinforcement learning that replaces observation reconstruction with joint-embedding prediction, enabling latent imagination for centralized training and decentralized execution, and demonstrates strong performance on SMAC.

Abstract: World models improve sample efficiency by training policies on imagined trajectories, but their usefulness depends on learning representations that capture the information needed for future control. We study whether self-supervised joint-embedding prediction (JEPA) can provide this learning signal for multi-agent reinforcement learning. We introduce MA-JEPA, a stochastic world model that replaces observation reconstruction with prediction of target representations, enabling model-based multi-agent reinforcement learning with centralized training and decentralized execution. A categorical latent state and a causal Transformer are trained with posterior and action-conditioned dynamics prediction objectives and are then used for actor-critic learning from latent imagination. A training-only joint predictor conditions on all agents' local states and actions to predict each agent's next local observation embedding. These predictions are passed through the same local posterior used during real interaction with a centralized critic that is used only for value learning, with execution remaining decentralized. Our experiments show that this architecture performs strongly on SMAC, matching or exceeding the strongest reported comparator mean win rate on four of eight evaluated maps.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过在想象轨迹上训练策略来提高样本效率，但其有效性取决于能否学习到捕捉未来控制所需信息的表征。我们研究自监督联合嵌入预测（JEPA）能否为多智能体强化学习提供这种学习信号。我们提出MA-JEPA，一种随机世界模型，用目标表征的预测替代观测重建，从而支持集中训练与分散执行的基于模型的多智能体强化学习。分类潜状态和因果Transformer通过后验及动作条件动力学预测目标进行训练，随后用于基于潜在想象的行动者-评论家学习。一个仅用于训练的联合预测器以所有智能体的局部状态和动作作为条件，预测每个智能体的下一个局部观测嵌入。这些预测通过与实际交互中相同的局部后验传递，并与仅用于价值学习的集中式评论家结合，而执行过程保持分散。实验表明，该架构在SMAC上表现强劲，在八个评估地图中的四个地图上，其平均胜率匹配或超过了所报告的最强对比方法。

Authors: Brandon Gary Kaplowitz, Osaze James Obahor, Christian Schroeder de Witt

Precision As You Need: Stochastic Computing Is a Dense Adaptive Quantizer WorldModel

stochastic computing mixed-precision inference vision transformers world-model planning

简要说明：本文提出将随机计算用作密集自适应量化器，以实现视觉Transformer中的高效矩阵乘法，在包括世界模型规划在内的多种视觉任务中展示了与固定格式量化相当的性能，并引入了一种动态逐行混合精度策略。

TLDR: This paper proposes using stochastic computing as a dense adaptive quantizer for efficient matrix multiplication in vision transformers, demonstrating competitive performance across various vision tasks including world-model planning, and introduces a dynamic per-row mixed-precision policy.

Abstract: Matrix multiplications dominate the inference cost of modern transformer-based vision models, yet existing efficiency techniques such as post-training quantization and mixed-precision inference are largely limited to the small set of fixed-width formats (INT4, INT8, BF16, and FP16) supported by conventional accelerators. We revisit stochastic computing (SC) as a way to lift this constraint: viewed as a dense adaptive quantizer, SC controls precision by bit-stream length L rather than a fixed datapath, while each multiplication reduces to a single AND/XNOR gate. We build a GPU library that emulates SC matrix multiplication at scale, exposes stream lengths as first-class kernel arguments, and evaluates SC end-to-end on image classification, object detection and instance segmentation, class-conditional image generation, and visual world-model planning. On top of this substrate, we develop a dynamic per-row mixed-precision policy that assigns stream length per token or group at matched average budget, requires no retraining, and uses the same SC hardware across schedules. Across tasks, SC remains competitive with fixed-format INT quantization at matched bit budgets, while per-row mixed precision helps maintain accuracy at lower average stream lengths. These results provide software-level feasibility evidence that SC can serve as a dense-precision substrate for fine-grained mixed-precision inference on modern vision transformers.

摘要（中文）：矩阵乘法在现代基于Transformer的视觉模型的推理成本中占据主导地位，然而现有的效率技术，如训练后量化和混合精度推理，在很大程度上受限于传统加速器所支持的少量固定宽度格式（INT4、INT8、BF16和FP16）。我们重新审视随机计算（SC），将其作为一种突破此限制的途径：从密集自适应量化器的角度来看，SC通过比特流长度L而非固定数据路径来控制精度，同时每次乘法简化为一个与门/同或门。我们构建了一个GPU库，能够大规模模拟SC矩阵乘法，将流长度作为一等内核参数暴露，并在图像分类、目标检测与实例分割、类条件图像生成以及视觉世界模型规划中端到端评估SC性能。在此基础之上，我们开发了一种动态的逐行混合精度策略，在匹配的平均预算下为每个词元或组分配流长度，该策略无需重新训练，并且在不同调度方案中使用相同的SC硬件。在各种任务中，SC在匹配比特预算下与固定格式的INT量化保持竞争力，而逐行混合精度有助于在较低的平均流长度下维持准确性。这些结果提供了软件层面的可行性证据，表明SC能够作为现代视觉Transformer上细粒度混合精度推理的密集精度基础。

Authors: Haoran Jin, Kangqi Zhang, Jirong Yang, Barry Lyu, Qiuyi Ding, Ruijie Gao, Nathan Bleier

PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery Perception3D

vector polygon generation remote sensing topology benchmark complex polygons

简要说明：PolyTopoBench 提出了一个从遥感图像生成矢量多边形的基准，重点评估带孔和多环的复杂多边形，并发现现有方法在处理这些拓扑结构时表现不佳。

TLDR: PolyTopoBench introduces a benchmark for evaluating vector polygon generation from remote sensing imagery, focusing on complex polygons with holes and multiple rings, and shows that existing methods struggle with such topological structures.

Abstract: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing. Early pipelines predict raster masks and post-process them into polygons, which prevents end-to-end optimization and may miss small objects or introduce inaccurate vertices. Recent methods directly generate vector polygons, but most focus on simple exterior contours, while they either cannot represent complex polygons with holes or fail to preserve their topology. In this paper, we propose PolyTopoBench, a unified evaluation framework for vector polygon generation from RS images with explicit emphasis on complex polygons. PolyTopoBench evaluates both exterior and interior rings, and benchmarks 11 representative methods, including segmentation-based polygonization pipelines, vision foundation model baselines, and specialized vector polygon generators, on two RS-image datasets covering buildings, roads, vegetation, and unvegetated regions. Experiments show that existing methods often recover simple exterior boundaries but degrade substantially on polygons with holes or multiple rings. These results reveal complex polygon generation as an unresolved challenge and motivate topology-aware benchmarks and model designs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench.

摘要（中文）：矢量多边形生成将视觉输入（例如遥感图像）转换为矢量化的多边形几何结构，支持自动驾驶、矢量地图构建和遥感等应用。早期流程预测栅格掩码，并将其后处理为多边形，这阻碍了端到端优化，并且可能遗漏小目标或引入不准确的顶点。近期方法直接生成矢量多边形，但大多数聚焦于简单的外轮廓，要么无法表示带孔洞的复杂多边形，要么无法保持其拓扑结构。在本文中，我们提出了PolyTopoBench，一个面向遥感图像矢量多边形生成的统一评估框架，明确强调复杂多边形的处理。PolyTopoBench同时评估外环和内环，并在两个覆盖建筑物、道路、植被和非植被区域的遥感图像数据集上，对11种代表性方法进行基准测试，包括基于分割的多边形化流程、视觉基础模型基线以及专用矢量多边形生成器。实验表明，现有方法通常能够恢复简单的外边界，但在处理带孔洞或多环的多边形时性能显著下降。这些结果揭示出复杂多边形生成仍是一个未解决的挑战，并激励了拓扑感知的基准测试和模型设计。代码和数据可在https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench获取。

Authors: Zeping Liu, Ni Lao, Weiwei Sun, Gil Wolff, Yiqun Xie, Liang Zhao, Junfeng Jiao, Gengchen Mai

SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera Other

spatial reasoning 360 camera multimodal LLM spherical harmonics training-free

简要说明：SphMind 是一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，通过将语义感知与球面几何推理解耦，利用基于球谐函数的空间图和推理时几何接地，显著提升了 360 度相机下多模态大语言模型的空间推理能力。

TLDR: SphMind is a training-free, plug-and-play framework that enhances MLLM-based spatial reasoning with 360-degree cameras by decoupling semantic perception from spherical geometric reasoning, using a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph and Inference-Time Geometric Grounding to achieve significant improvements in directional reasoning benchmarks.

Abstract: Omnidirectional or 360 cameras provide embodied AI agents with a holistic, wide field-of-view (FoV) view of their surroundings, motivating the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for omnidirectional spatial reasoning. However, most MLLMs are trained on conventional 2D perspective images and struggle with the severe distortions and wrap-around discontinuities induced by spherical geometry. Enabling them to generalize to non-Euclidean 3D spaces without retraining therefore remains challenging. We propose SphMind, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that decouples semantic perception from geometric reasoning. Rather than requiring MLLMs to learn spherical geometry internally, SphMind preserves their semantic capabilities while handling geometry externally. We introduce a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG) that models spatial relationships through equivariant transformations on the sphere, together with Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG), a model-agnostic closed-loop optimization process that aligns MLLM representations with spherical geometric constraints during inference. Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning. In-the-wild evaluations further show that SphMind resolves directional reasoning queries that baseline vision-language models fail to answer correctly.

摘要（中文）：全方位或360度相机为具身AI智能体提供了对其周围环境的整体、宽视场（FoV）观察视角，从而推动了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在全向空间推理中的应用。然而，大多数MLLMs是在传统二维透视图像上训练的，难以应对球面几何带来的严重畸变和环绕不连续性问题。因此，在不进行重新训练的情况下使其泛化到非欧几里得三维空间仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了SphMind，一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，将语义感知与几何推理解耦。SphMind不要求MLLMs在内部学习球面几何，而是在外部处理几何问题的同时保留其语义能力。我们引入了一种基于球谐函数的空间图（SHSG），通过球面上的等变变换建模空间关系，并结合推理时几何接地（IGG），这是一种与模型无关的闭环优化过程，在推理过程中将MLLM表示与球面几何约束对齐。在三个基准上的实验表明，SphMind在MP3D和Stanford2D-3D上的方向推理平均提升了21.4%以上，在真实世界的ODI-Bench上比提示工程基线高出8.7%，并且在全景旋转下将旋转不变性提升了5.9%，且无需额外训练或特定数据集调优。野外评估进一步表明，SphMind能够解决基线视觉-语言模型无法正确回答的方向推理查询。

Authors: Shriram Damodaran, Soumyaratna Debnath, Cheston Tan, Lin Wang

MultiEcho: An Experimental Science of Learned Worlds WorldModel

counterfactual interventions response laws physical correspondence frozen model configurations learned-world laws

简要说明：本文提出了MultiEcho框架，通过受控反事实干预估计世界模型的响应规律，并测试其与物理对应的一致性。

TLDR: This paper introduces MultiEcho, a framework for estimating the response laws of world models through controlled counterfactual interventions, testing their physical correspondence across simulated systems.

Abstract: World models can be studied as experimental systems with response laws of their own. We introduce MultiEcho, a framework for estimating these laws through controlled counterfactual interventions, delimiting their applicability, and separately testing their physical correspondence. Across nine simulated physical systems and seven frozen model configurations, three-reference estimators predict complete intervention responses and recover intervention parameters. Estimator selection uses discovery data only; frozen fits are evaluated on validation and confirmation contexts. The experiments distinguish response predictability, intervention readability and physical accuracy. Responses can be locally describable yet poorly match physical effects in the same target coordinates. Event-window, visibility and camera interventions reveal conditional applicability, and paired generator configurations show reduced readability under a scene prompt with stronger guidance. Magnitude sweeps expose small image errors alongside large relative effect errors. An exact-reset material experiment separates registered visible-response success from fixed-readout failure on material-dependent futures at matched positions and velocities. Exact finite-scale identities resolve odd and even response errors; first-order remainder bounds specify when refined calibration converges. MultiEcho provides an experimental basis for studying learned-world laws independently of, and in relation to, physical laws.

摘要（中文）：世界模型可以被视为具有自身响应规律的实验系统。我们引入了MultiEcho框架，通过受控反事实干预来估计这些规律，界定其适用范围，并分别检验其与物理现实的对应关系。在九个模拟物理系统和七种冻结模型配置中，三参考估计器能够预测完整的干预响应并恢复干预参数。估计器的选择仅使用发现数据；冻结模型的拟合结果则在验证和确认情境中进行评估。实验区分了响应可预测性、干预可读性和物理准确性。响应可能在局部可描述，但在相同目标坐标下与物理效果匹配较差。事件窗口、可见性和相机干预揭示了条件的适用性，而配对生成器配置在具有更强引导的场景提示下显示出可读性降低。幅度扫描暴露了较小的图像误差与较大的相对效果误差。一项精确重置的物理实验将已注册的可见响应成功与在匹配位置和速度下对依赖物质的未来状态的固定读数失败区分开来。精确的有限尺度恒等式解析了奇偶响应误差；一阶余项界限规定了细化校准何时收敛。MultiEcho为独立于物理定律并与之关联地研究学习世界规律提供了实验基础。
